'''Leviani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as chief of security at the [[Yarith Bespin/Legends|Yarith Bespin]], a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
